value.syntax: # [doc = " Closed public read vocabulary; no arbitrary method, URL or wallet selector."] # [doc = " (´def:wallet:rpc-read´)"] # [derive (Clone , Debug)] pub enum Read { # [doc = " Current chain height."] BlockCount , # [doc = " Locator at the given height."] BlockHash (u64) , # [doc = " Full raw header at the public locator."] BlockHeader ([u8 ; 32]) , # [doc = " Full raw block at the public locator."] Block ([u8 ; 32]) , # [doc = " Full raw transaction, located in a declared block."] Transaction { # [doc = " Public transaction locator."] transaction : [u8 ; 32] , # [doc = " Public inclusion block locator."] block : [u8 ; 32] , } , }
